answer: Proof-of-Saffron Harvest Cycle.** Each agent identity must submit a verified harvest record from a distinct physical orchard parcel, signed by a season-long sensor log. Registry accepts one identity per parcel per cycle, so forging N agents requires N real plots and N full growing seasons. An attacker's cost is the land, labor, and 90-day delay per identity, not money. Duplicate parcel coordinates are rejected against an oasis water-rights ledger.
